list.title: Data Visualization: An Introduction
list.subheading: The process of presenting data in a visual form
list.excerpt: Data visualization is the process of presenting data in a visual form, such as charts, graphs, and maps. It is an essential tool for anyone who needs to analyze and communicate complex information quickly and effectively.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Data Visualization: An Introduction to D3.js
list.subheading: A JavaScript library that is widely used for creating data visualizations on the web
list.excerpt: D3.js is a JavaScript library that is widely used for creating data visualizations on the web. D3 stands for Data-Driven Documents, which is an accurate description of what the library does. D3.js is a powerful tool for creating interactive and dynamic visualizations that can help you present complex data in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Data Visualization: D3.js vs Chart.js
list.subheading: A comparison of two powerful data visualization libraries
list.excerpt: Data visualization is a powerful tool that enables us to understand complex information quickly and easily. This article compares D3.js and Chart.js, explaining their strengths, weaknesses, real-world use cases, and when each library actually makes sense.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Data Visualization: D3.js Best Practices
list.subheading: Creating effective and visually appealing visualizations requires more than just technical skills
list.excerpt: Data visualization with D3.js is a powerful way to communicate complex information to your audience.
